By the end of the series, we will have a better-informed citizenry that is pro-active in issues of democracy, human rights and governance. name: The Constitution

By the end of the series, we will have a better-informed citizenry that is pro-active in issues of democracy, human rights and governance. Rights holders will know what they can/should demand from duty bearers and will be able to hold them accountable for delivery. The programme will also stimulate greater transparency among duty bearers as they will know that the public knows its rights and what to expect from them.
